Definition: of Chaldee origin (compare H7386); O empty one, i.e. thou worthless (as a term of utter vilification):--Raca.
BiblicalUsage: Whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council. The word is empty one, worthless one, and Jesus sets it beside murder in the Sermon on the Mount.
TheologicalSignificance: What I take from this is that contempt is murder begun in the mouth, and Jesus judges the word before the deed.
